blurb: 红石成因 · 群象睡美人 · 阴阳石 · 别传寺

stops.title: Stop A: How the red land was born — and how it got its scientific name
stops.sceneHook: 红崖剖面 / 成因解说牌

stops.title: Stop B: China Ruby Park — the big picture in numbers
Stop 1: Jinjiang River — “The Elephants Crossing the River”
Stop 3: Yangyuan Hill and Yangyuan Stone
Stop 4: Yinyuan Cliff — Nature’s Adam and Eve
Stop 5: Biechuan Temple and the chameleon dragon

sentences.en: Good morning, everyone.
sentences.zh: 各位早上好。

sentences.en: Welcome to Guangdong.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到广东。

sentences.en: Today we visit Danxia Mountain, about forty-five kilometers northeast of Shaoguan City — a world-famous red-stone landscape and the namesake of a whole geological term.
sentences.zh: 今天我们游览丹霞山，它位于韶关市东北约四十五公里处——这里是世界著名的红石景观，也是一种地质术语的命名地。

sentences.en: In Lingnan travel talk, it ranks among the four most famous mountains of the region: Danxia, Luofu, Xiqiao, and Dinghu.
sentences.zh: 在岭南旅游口语里，它位列岭南四大名山之中：丹霞、罗浮、西樵和鼎湖。

sentences.en: Geological studies show that twenty-five million years ago, this place was a vast, low-lying lake.
sentences.zh: 地质研究表明，两千五百万年前，这里还是一片广阔低洼的湖泊。

sentences.en: Later, movements of the earth’s crust lifted the land; the lake water receded; and the sediment at the bottom gradually oxidized into red rocks.
sentences.zh: 后来地壳运动抬升了地面，湖水退去，湖底的沉积物逐渐氧化成红色岩石。

sentences.en: That is how the glowing red cliffs you see today were formed.
sentences.zh: 你们今天看到的这些鲜红崖壁，就是这样形成的。

sentences.en: In the 1930s, Professor Chen Guoda of Sun Yat-sen University made an intensive study of Danxia Mountain and other red-rock mountains in South China.
sentences.zh: 二十世纪三十年代，中山大学的陈国达 Chen Guoda 教授对丹霞山以及华南其他红岩山体做了深入研究。

sentences.en: He named this kind of red-rock land configuration the “Danxia Landform.” The name was soon accepted worldwide.
sentences.zh: 他把这种红岩地貌命名为“丹霞地貌”。这个名称很快被全世界接受。

sentences.en: From then on, wherever you find landscapes of red sandstone conglomerate with sheer, red cliffs, geologists call them Danxia landform.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，凡是见到由红色砂砾岩构成、崖壁陡峭鲜红的景观，地质学家都称之为丹霞地貌。

sentences.en: Places featuring Danxia landform can be found on all continents except Antarctica — for example, the Grand Canyon in the United States and some areas in Saxony, Germany.
sentences.zh: 除南极洲外，各大洲都能找到丹霞地貌——比如美国的大峡谷，以及德国萨克森的一些地区。

sentences.en: But Danxia Mountain itself is the largest, the most typical, and the most beautiful of its kind.
sentences.zh: 但丹霞山本身，是同类中规模最大、最典型、也最美的一处。

sentences.en: Please look around.
sentences.zh: 请大家环顾四周。

sentences.en: The mountain covers 319 square kilometers, with over 600 red rock peaks standing out against green woods — like a garden of ruby sculptures.
sentences.zh: 这座山占地三百一十九平方公里，六百多座红岩峰峦挺立在绿林之间——像一座红宝石雕塑园。

sentences.en: That is why it is also called China Ruby Park, or China Red Stone Park.
sentences.zh: 所以它又被称为中国红石公园，或中国红宝石公园 China Ruby Park。

sentences.en: In 1995, the Chinese State Council approved it as a geological nature reserve.
sentences.zh: 一九九五年，国务院批准它为地质自然保护区。

sentences.en: Now, let’s walk the classic viewing route — from river to bridge, from “yang” to “yin,” and finally into the temple.
sentences.zh: 接下来，我们走经典观景路线——从江到桥，从“阳”到“阴”，最后进入寺庙。

sentences.en: Please look at the rocks beyond the Jinjiang River.
sentences.zh: 请看锦江对岸的那些岩石。

sentences.en: They look like a herd of elephants wading across toward us — trunks, tusks, ears, and eyes all lifelike.
sentences.zh: 它们像一群大象正涉水向我们走来——象鼻、象牙、耳朵和眼睛都栩栩如生。

sentences.en: So this sight is named “The Elephants Crossing the River.”
sentences.zh: 所以这处景观叫作“群象过江” The Elephants Crossing the River。

sentences.en: Now we stand on Yangyuan Bridge.
sentences.zh: 现在我们站在阳元桥上。

sentences.en: Please look to your right, at the hill in the distance.
sentences.zh: 请向右边看，远处那座山。

sentences.en: It looks like a young girl lying down to sleep: from right to left, her head, neck, chest, and belly are clearly outlined.
sentences.zh: 它像一位少女躺着入睡：从右到左，头、颈、胸、腹轮廓清晰。

sentences.en: This sight is called “The Sleeping Belle,” or “The Beautiful Girl Blocking the River” — Yu Nü Lan Jiang.
sentences.zh: 这处景观叫“睡美人” The Sleeping Belle，也叫“玉女拦江” Yu Nü Lan Jiang。

sentences.en: Next is Yangyuan Hill, meaning “the Hill of Male Sex.” The famous stone column here — Yangyuan Stone — is about 28 meters high and 7 meters in diameter, and it looks strikingly like the male organ.
sentences.zh: 下一站是阳元山，意思是“男性之山”。这里著名的石柱——阳元石——高约二十八米，直径约七米，外形酷似男性生殖器。

sentences.en: Geological studies show it was once part of the cliff; over three hundred thousand years, Nature severed it from the mountain and carved it into this shape.
sentences.zh: 地质研究表明，它原是崖壁的一部分；历经约三十万年，大自然把它从山体分离，并雕成今天的样子。

sentences.en: In the old days, men were regarded as superior to women, and people prayed for more sons to carry on the family name, so pilgrims often worshiped this stone.
sentences.zh: 旧时重男轻女，人们祈求多子以续香火，所以香客常来朝拜这块石头。

sentences.en: Nearby is Yinyuan Cliff, formed some one hundred thousand years ago.
sentences.zh: 附近是阴元石景区，大约形成于十万年前。

sentences.en: Just as God sculptured Adam and Eve in the Garden of Eden, Nature carved a stone husband and wife here in Danxia.
sentences.zh: 正如上帝在伊甸园里塑造了亚当和夏娃，大自然也在丹霞雕出了一对石质夫妻。

sentences.en: What a wonderful world this is!
sentences.zh: 这世界真奇妙啊！

sentences.en: Finally, Biechuan Temple, built in 1662, the first year of Emperor Kangxi’s reign.
sentences.zh: 最后是别传寺，建于一六六二年，也就是康熙元年。

sentences.en: In the Qing Dynasty it was thronged with pilgrims and ranked among the three largest Buddhist monasteries in northern Guangdong.
sentences.zh: 清代这里香火鼎盛，位列粤北三大佛寺之一。

sentences.en: Inside the Sakyamuni Hall, please look at a rock shaped like a dragon.
sentences.zh: 在大雄宝殿里，请看一块形似龙的岩石。

sentences.en: It is called “Bian Se Long” — the chameleon — because its color changes with the seasons: light green in spring, dark green in summer, yellowish green in autumn, and brownish yellow in winter.
sentences.zh: 它叫“变色龙”——颜色随季节而变：春浅绿、夏深绿、秋黄绿、冬棕黄。

sentences.en: So Danxia is both a geology classroom and a picture book: an ancient lake turned red, a name that traveled the world, elephants in the river, a sleeping girl on the bridge, a stone couple of yin and yang, and a temple dragon that changes color.
sentences.zh: 所以丹霞既是地质课堂，又是一本画册：古湖变红、名字走向世界、江中群象、桥上睡美人、阴阳石夫妻，还有会变色的寺中龙。

sentences.en: If examiners ask about formation, naming, or any of these scenes, you already have the answers in this route.
sentences.zh: 如果考官问起成因、命名，或这些景观中的任何一处，这条路线里你都已经有答案了。

sentences.en: I’m ready for your questions.
sentences.zh: 欢迎大家提问。
